_note: Phase 3 re-baseline (2026-09-13), real twin-wasm solver, default radius-4 study area around Fairfax City (36,166 edges). Recorded with COOP/COEP on and the two other Phase-3 agents building and benchmarking on the same machine, so the load metrics carry roughly +/-25% run-to-run noise - a single failure here is worth re-running before believing. firstBaselineMs improved against the Phase-2 baseline (2685.9 ms) because of the 2.5 solver work landing in the same tree, not because of anything in the web app.
_isochrone: firstIsochroneMs is a duration - origin drop to first reach result - not a page timestamp, and it is measured against the STUB transit backend (straight-line reach over the resident nodes). Re-baseline it once twin-wasm/src/transit.rs lands; a routed isochrone will not be 191 ms.
_layers: heapBytesAllLayers is the heap with every AVAILABLE registry layer on. Today the tiles carry only roads and buildings, so it is nearly heapBytesAfterLoad; it will move when the Phase-3 tiles land.
_fps: Software GL (swiftshader), overlay on - single digits are expected and only comparable against another swiftshader run.
